arStrings.szText: Casting or Channeling an {c_important}Earth{/c} Skill has a {c_number}{SF_0}%{/c} chance to trigger a free {c_important}Storm{/c} Skill of the same category, and vice versa. You deal {c_number}[{SF_5} * 100|%x|]{/c} more {c_important}Earth{/c} and {c_important}Storm{/c} damage and these free Skills count as both.
